body.objective: Run the first action-specific quantum preflight for the selected two-phase counterflow causal parent: classify its local anomaly complex and determine whether its free reduced gravity--relative-clock carrier admits a BRST-compatible Hadamard covariance.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal counterflow causal parent, gauge-fixed Hessian, cyclic pairing and Green homotopies by exact hashes. First classify the complete local ghost-number-one BV anomaly quotient of the changed gravity--two-phase--auxiliary-U1 theory within declared dimension/derivative/antifield bounds, keeping it distinct from strict Weyl and the earlier one-complex-clock Berger theory. Then construct or obstruct a quasifree two-point function on the full causal BV complex with the correct antisymmetric part, Hadamard wavefront set, Q Ward identity, real structure, K_Berger stationarity and fixed-charge zero-mode treatment. Compute the descended form on physical cohomology and report its inertia without calling a reduced Krein carrier a particle Hilbert space. Provide exact cohomology witnesses, microlocal/domain receipts, independent rails, anomaly/positivity mutations, schema, atlas fragment and Paper 12 disposition.
body.current_gate: local anomaly and free Hadamard/BRST compatibility of the selected changed theory
